output.expected_benefit: Reduce time spent drafting press releases from ~3 hours to ~1.5 hours per draft, improving efficiency for the team.
requirements: Draft press releases from published reports and internal briefing notes (internal data only).
Generate first versions of press releases, ensuring accuracy and alignment with the source material.
Allow manual editing and approval by communications officers before publication.
Integrate with existing workflows for reports and briefing notes.
Maintain confidentiality of internal information used in drafting.
